title: HDF System
description: Describes a system's authorization boundary, components, and interconnections. Maps to OSCAL SSP system-characteristics and FedRAMP system inventory.

name.description: Human-readable system name. Example: 'Enterprise Portal Production'.

identifier.description: System identifier from an authoritative source. Example: eMASS system ID, FedRAMP package ID.

identifierScheme.description: URI identifying the scheme of the system identifier. Example: 'https://emass.mil', 'https://fedramp.gov'.

description.description: Description of the system's purpose and mission.

authorizationDate.description: Date the current authorization status was granted. ISO 8601 format.

boundaryDescription.description: Description of the system's authorization boundary. Example: network CIDR blocks, cloud VPC IDs, physical locations.

components.description: Logical components within the system boundary. Each component groups targets via label selectors and references applicable baselines.

controlDesignations.description: Declares which controls are common, hybrid, or system-specific, and which component provides them. Maps to NIST SP 800-53 control designations and OSCAL leveraged-authorizations.

interconnections.description: Connections to external systems that cross the authorization boundary.

labels.description: Optional key-value labels for grouping and querying systems.

checksum.description: Cryptographic checksum for integrity verification of this system document.

name.description: Name of the tool that generated this document.

generator.description: Information about the tool that generated this system document.

components.name: WebTier
components.description: RHEL 9 web servers running the portal
